purpose: Rust parser and lifecycle fixture coverage manifest for Interactive Brokers adapter parity gates.

fixture_groups.product_scope: IB contract details, Nautilus instrument IDs, product family normalization, and BAG spread handling
covers: stock, FX, crypto, future, option/FOP, index, CFD, commodity, bond, and spread surfaces
contract ID and price magnifier cache

fixture_groups.product_scope: IB live data subscriptions and Nautilus data conversion
IB historical bars, ticks, instruments, and duration segmentation
IB submit, modify, cancel, order list, and order/fill update handling
IB account summary, PnL, position, and margin lifecycle
IB TWS/Gateway connection smoke and optional Dockerized gateway helper

scoped_blockers.summary: Interactive Brokers now has compact fixture manifests, but parity closure remains assigned to RADP-018.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Closed by RADP-017 compact manifest coverage for IB instrument, market data, historical, execution, account, and gateway lifecycle groups.

scoped_blockers.summary: Interactive Brokers requires an external TWS/IB Gateway session and UTC timestamp configuration.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: IB automation requires external TWS/IB Gateway state, UTC timestamp configuration, and env-gated live smoke.

scoped_blockers.summary: Interactive Brokers product-family support is broad but still needs compact release classification.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: the fixture pins broad product-family support and keeps unsupported or filtered security types explicit.

scoped_blockers.summary: Interactive Brokers market-data subscriptions are IB API specific and not generic Nautilus coverage.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: market data remains limited to IB quote, trade, bar, L1/L2 depth, index, and option-greek semantics recorded by the fixture.

scoped_blockers.summary: Interactive Brokers historical requests have explicit IB pacing and bar/tick constraints.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: historical bars, ticks, instruments, and duration segmentation stay bound to IB request limits.

scoped_blockers.summary: Interactive Brokers execution order lifecycle is implemented with explicit order-shape constraints.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: order transformation, submit/modify/cancel, fills, and spread handling remain limited by the rejection boundaries pinned in the fixture.

scoped_blockers.summary: Interactive Brokers account, position, PnL, reconnect, and gateway lifecycle need mock, fixture, or explicit scope decisions.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Scoped as supported with constraints: live operational lifecycle remains env-gated or Docker/gateway dependent, with static fixture evidence for release traceability.

scoped_blockers.summary: Optional Interactive Brokers legacy bridge surfaces remain until RREM-018 closed the scoped removal gate.
scoped_blockers.resolution: Deferred to the Rust-only removal gate because RADP-018 is superseded by RREM-018 removal authorization.
